title: Overdrive original two-disk IPF release supplied locally

build.scope: Five unchanged Alien Breed native root sources. The baseline freshly compiles the native root using eleven retained component DLL inputs. The correction rebuilds Exec from84 recorded sources with only BootstrapCore.cs changed, retaining ten other component DLLs and the frozen SDK/compiler/graphics composer. Graphics source installer and private resident stay at FF8000. Separate from complete moving-main/MorphOS ROM and standard-app qualification.

tests.coverage: Exact externally hashed ROMs and generated original boot disks exercise real guest APIs; source host/MC68000 checks have separate moving producer dependencies. No skipped tests counted as media coverage.

initialHashCaseProbeAttempts.coverage: UNAVAILABLE: fixture rejected lowercase expected hash before guest execution. Corrected invocations are separately named -verified.

exploration.backportBuildRetry: First test build stopped after no progress; no coverage. An isolated retry exposed a test assuming Chip was the first list entry. A fixed-address attempt exposed main-specific header placement. Final test locates the Chip bank by attributes, retaining its physical-bounds assertion. Earlier failing TRXs are retained under probes/backport and probes/backport-fixed.

receiptMode: --firmware native disables private receipt interpretation after takeover without changing guest execution. ROM hashes identify firmware.
limits: Bounded original-disk intro, menu, disk swap and qualifying input only; later tracks, complete laps/races/game, saves and other profiles remain unverified.
Frozen-component native image; complete current-main/MorphOS ROM and standard application remain unqualified by these replays.
No engine/CPU change, caller-data guard, game/opcode/media patch, host OS shim or package publication.
Sampled PCM equality is not listening/audio-fidelity qualification; correctness diagnostics are not throughput or physical-timing acceptance.

mainBackport.scope: Narrow change over the Alien Breed Supervisor backport, preserving current-main bootstrap/task-completion layout. Only the legacy native source composition was ROM/media qualified.

correctedAllocationTrace.interpretation: The original unchanged loader now receives an A501 buffer for its second allocation, before any disk-two input or game-state differences.
